recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Only revisit the current PlanDefinition/$apply result wording under a new CDS tracker if the work group wants a broader semantic change.
issue_request: FHIR-14396 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 CDS change request asking to replace confusing use of "render" in the $apply operation description with wording that says the operation applies a PlanDefinition to context and produces a CarePlan based on available data.
initial_application: SVN 13332 / git d73633fa577ac98c9cf467f762361756cb8b9b1a applied the issue by changing the Clinical Reasoning knowledge artifact representation page from "render a plan definition" to "apply a plan definition" and by updating the ActivityDefinition and PlanDefinition $apply spreadsheet rows.
additional_context: ActivityDefinition, PlanDefinition, and RequestOrchestration are active in source/fhir.ini. Since STU3, FHIR-25056, FHIR-33169, FHIR-46313, and FHIR-51557 changed or clarified PlanDefinition/$apply output semantics from CarePlan-only to Resource/RequestGroup/RequestOrchestration and then Bundles of request resources, so the exact STU3 resolution sentence is no longer the right current wording.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the original wording problem is already absent and changing current operation text back to the STU3 CarePlan-only phrasing would conflict with later applied decisions.

related_jiras.note: Added RequestGroup as an output option for PlanDefinition/$apply, making the original CarePlan-only result wording stale.
Changed PlanDefinition/$apply processing semantics to return Bundles centered on RequestGroup/RequestOrchestration behavior.
Relaxed PlanDefinition/$apply output to Bundles of request resources including CarePlan, RequestOrchestration, and individual request resources.
Clarified the multi-cardinality Bundle return parameter after the newer output semantics.
